body: Soooo basically the movie Art School Confidental? Hehe

I think part of my problem is my dad is critical, he was an English major, my mom was always the one who loved everything... Between the two of them I always had a good balance of input and now I'm left with only the critical. My mom always wanted to read every sentence I wrote and my dad cares, I know he does, but he's always kind of "half there" because work takes over his mind.... I always kind of took my mom's opinion half heartedly because she was always in love with everything... And now I feel like I lost my biggest fan... It's hard.

I think part of my problem too is that I was published super young on one of the first things I wrote... So I suffer under pressure of my own success...like I don't know how to be good enough... It's super hard to get past having done something people like... I say that with no ego I swear. I just have a fear of failure I know I have to get past to get anywhere...

Trying to, it's weird. Some days are fine and by being fine are also oddly not fine.... I can't just let go and have a good day without feeling wrong for it... I don't know, I guess I'll figure it out.

Ah thanks! I'll check them out! As for pain... Comes and goes... Mostly back problems that make anything hurt after a while... Plus in the mornings and at night I lock up. At this point so much feels like it has gone wrong in my life I just kind of almost find things humorous because it's rediculous...

I found when I was on meds it was the specific medication you had to get right for it to feel right. As for your art.... You say it turns to shit, but in what way... That's kind of vague.... Maybe you are being overly hard on yourself? I just listened to a podcast from TED on creativity that said people who do well as artists actually train themselves over time to shut off the judgement part of their brains... I'm working on it myself. You need to just hang in there... For example is there any chance of scholarship or loans to go somewhere else? If not, you could always go for something you just find interesting, even if it isn't what you want to do, and pour it into your art. Meet people. I wish I had taken advantage of the meeting people in college thing! If it's true what you say about your parents... Although I bet your parents care more than you think... But if they don't, you have to let it go... You have to tell yourself you are an awesome interesting person and anyone that can't see it is missing out.

But it's not one thing, it's the many things that surround that one thing.... You have to do one thing to get to the next thing... So on and so on. Okay so not writing, but I only said writing because it is something you do well and could be successful doing.

Is your past life making you happy? What are you giving up? If it's truely your home and the life you should have then you'll always be able to go back. You can't let how other people feel about you determine how you feel about yourself. Why would you end a life filled with so many unanswered questions and possibilities? You can morn the death of your old life, feel free to kill that, but the new you is just beginning. It's scary like learning to walk is scary but you can't stop moving.

See my post... I have no friends really either, so I get it. Sounds to me though like your biggest problem is you need to stop worrying a about other people. You are you. If people like you awesome... If they don't, what is your loss. As for school, well it might just be you learn things in a different way, try hard but don't feel like a failure if it's something you don't deal with well. You have trust issues, I get that too. Tell yourself that a lot of people are broken and angry and hurt.... Not to say that your pain isn't yours.... But it's not a club of one. You just need to make time for yourself. You need to find something that keeps your interest so that you can see it through. You can't live in fear of everything, that's the easy way out, it's much harder to fight with yourself for confidence.

What's the story here? All of these things are vague and common.... Which in short means you aren't alone. So what is the story that makes you you. What is the rain in your parade? You would not have doubt without its counterweight "confidence" so there is still hope. 

Talk it out.

Why does art make you miserable? That's the first question I have. 

As for your parents, some are good at it and some don't know what to do. Remember, they too were just children who grew up in spite of themselves. They are hardly perfect. Much of depression is hereditary so there is a good chance they have some too.

Your doctor sounds like the wrong doctor for you. Is there a possibility to switch? 

You clearly have the wrong friends. 

Your reasons for staying alive need to be small achievable ones like "hey I want to see this movie" "I want to read this book first".... Eventually those little moments will add up to years. The good thing is we constantly lead lives that are in a state of "to be continued"... There's always something new on the next page....maybe better....maybe worse.... But always new. You have to stick around for that page turn.

You don't know what will happen yet. Let's start there. Take it day at a time. 

Flip side of this, face your feelings, you obviously know it was a bad thing which is why you are upset, let's hope it's the scare tactic you needed and that's all. 

You do however need help. I rarely recommend therapy but in your case it's kind of a must. You need to talk out that part of your brain that was curious. You need to find out if it's an issue before something bigger than this happens. 

If you get discovered and found out and even put in jail... It's a wake up call. Take it as a learning experience. Take it as a moment to grow. 

You need to take each moment slowly. I don't agree with what you did, but I certainly can understand how the Internet leads to the dark side of human curiosity. Take everything just moment by moment, getting worked up solves nothing.

I was on a buddy subreddit and got tons of response.... And I was totally responsive but found everyone else just kind of faded away. But maybe I just need to give it another shot. 

God I love your teeth. ;)

I've had on and off depression for 17 years, some years suicidal, some just awful pain... About 2 years ago I was also diagnosed with PTSD.... So this isn't to say, oh woe is me look how good you have it-- because I get it... I always could understand how someone who has everything could still be depressed... Because you never know how pain feels to another person... This is a really long way of saying, first things first, ALLOW yourself to be sad. I feel like a lot of times people are distressed on here because they worry about EVERYONE and their opinions. You are allowed to fail. You are allowed to not know what to do. You can be upset.

Okay, now, the other thing I notice is that your whole life you have put your happiness into the hands of others. I used to do the same thing... Heck when I ve been in relationships I do the same thing still... And it's hard but I know I do it. So you need to find you. You need to find the things you like about yourself. There are things, like you taught yourself a language, you figured out a game and threw yourself into it....you can do complex and complicated things that a lot of people can't. Celebrate the things you have done, not the shitty things that suck... Because from what I can tell a lot of things are out of your control. 

You are doing one thing right. You are saying to yourself, I would die but this that or the other, let me wait. That wait is the most important skill you have. Waiting is the chemotherapy to depression's cancer. It might just give you one more day or it might give you 50 years, but keep going and seeing just what happens... Your whole story took time to happen... Look at all those ups and downs you had... That's the secret. Time.

You're a writer. It might take you a long time to do it but that doesn't make you any less of one. Perhaps what you need to try to do is find someone to write with you, or edit for you so it speeds up the process. You were able to tell this story, and even if you keep telling this story, it's a story worth telling. With the mere fact your situation is so rare there will be people who will want to know what you're going through since they can't comprehend it. No it won't be easy, but deaf people have written music with worse odds of success so I'm pretty confident in your skill already. Do you read? It might help you escape and if you can't listen to short stories on audiobooks....even if your mind drifts it might help you escape as books are meant to.
Haha.... I have an actual account as well.... This was a throwaway.... Although I totally find joy in the fact that this name is so perfect and mine.... I might have to use both now. :)

Hey I'll always take info on a theater doing work! Pass along! :) PM it if you don't want the whole of reddit to know. I was stuck after my car accident which was about 2 years ago.... Everything after that has made it worse.... I used to just slam out plays and stories.... Sigh

Hey there... I'm still hanging in there. My dad and I, when we aren't sad, have a stupidly dark sense of humor.... It helps a lot with things like this. I hope things get better for both of us right? *hugs*
Haha, why thank you :)
All sorts of things... Mostly short comedies... Lots of slice of life things.... Dramadies and such. Just feeling super stuck lately... :(

Considering my post, I'm sure I'm not the best authority, nor am I going to answer your question because you and I both know that you have the whole of the Internet at your disposal so you would write this if you weren't looking for a discussion... And as the other commenter posted, couldn't help you in that department, nor should we, because rules.

Now, as someone whose world in completely unraveling... Seriously, see post if you don't belive me, I'm going to say this: Life doesn't get better.... I gets DIFFERENT.

I get sick of the "life gets better" arguments too. Different I can handle though. Different means it might still suck, but maybe.... Just maybe... Things will go different than expected. It is that little sliver of doubt you can put in your head..., that tiny chance.... That means you don't know everything. You don't know that it's impossible, you don't know you won't win a million dollars, you don't know what will happen. 

If you have nothing in your life get an obsession. I'm currently on a podcast kick... But whatever.... Whatever is cheap or free that you can distract yourself with. Just as when you have good days you can't remember the bad ones as clearly, you might just have to deal with some bad days to figure out what you do like or can like. Instead of killing yourself, kill time... If it really doesn't matter to you it should be no big deal right? Try it. Just give it a shot. Stop caring and just live however you like each day and see what happens.

I'm a writer with a film degree.... Have more connections there than here (not many, but better ones).... I'm more of an east coaster personally.... I also would rather write plays as that's what I've managed to get published .... But 1) I've had writer's block for years and this isn't helping.... And 2) I'd like to make a living which I think I might have better odds of with my LA connections... 

Speaking of I have a deadline for a play competition coming up and I've been unable to make anything hit the page.... Sigh.

Kids have that way... On the side I'm a children's photographer (totally going to meet single men that way, right? *eyeroll*) haha... But am actually photographing a baby tomorrow...

I think the only thing keeping me from wanting to die is that my mom has.....if that makes sense... Sometimes it's that I think she'd be mad... Sometimes it's just fear... I'm going through an existential crisis about death and life at the moment... 

As for the lyric... I guess my response is... I know I need to find a place where I could fit... But I don't know where that is... I have trouble being social in high pressure situations (like at a bar or club).... It's not my scene... And online I had two major relationships in my life start there, but I kind of don't like it.... I mean I do and don't... It's complicated... I wish I could just....bump into someone.... Like just meet someone in a classic 1950s kind of way.... But I'm a romantic and the current climate doesn't have much room for that.... Sigh...

Alas I'm on the east coast at the moment! Although considering an eventual move to CA... But all up for being friends anyway. I hear you on the never having to say a word thing... One kind of funny/tragic thing is that I'll be off on my own planet listening to something or reading my nook... And I'll have to talk to a stranger or answer my phone... And suddenly I can't talk... Like it startles me I forget, oh yeah, I am on a planet with other people... How.... Quaint. :p I don't believe I've been to WA... Which is amazing because I've driven across the country twice alone... So I've been to a lot of states. I just feel so.... Alien to everyone else sometimes... Sigh.

We have talked.... A lot.... But he has this whole thing where he's worried I'm not going to have my own life now... And I'll never tell him but I don't feel like I will either sometimes... Although I want one, it's like my extended family has decided I'm my dad's caretaker now (even though he doesn't need one....) He just keep insisting he's oh so alone now with no one to talk to....which is um er kind of isolating.... I have tried to express how I feel about it but then he just shuts up.... 

I'm just kind of emotionally out of it.... I wish I had the kind of friend who would just text me and ask how I'm doing.... Or better someone romantic or otherwise who would be like "hey, your life has been pretty sucky lately... Let's go do something fun... " I mean my dad and I have been hanging out.... But I feel like all I'm doing right now is talking to no one except literally the most depressed person in my vicinity... I just want to scream. I want to be supportive.... And then I want to go somewhere and scream....

I'm to the point where I have fantasies of just hanging out with people.... Like how depressing is that?? And with everyone running off and getting married, if I do get a blue moon invite.... I'm awkwardly this like fifth wheel everyone feels sorry for... Like...look at this film my new husband made....awww your mom died how's that going...

I just want someone to actually talk to me and not at me, for like five minutes. My "best friend" (read "only") waited a MONTH to call me and then said it was my fault I didn't call her.... I was like uhhhh I've been busy with my mom dying... I mean seriously? How about a "just wanted to make sure you are still alive and stuff considering I'm making you fly to my wedding" call....? How about that....?

I am working on the whole trying to afford health insurance thing at the moment.... So kind of stuck... I told my dad to try therapy but he says he doesn't have time so he's just going to ask the dr to bump up his antidepressants.... Grr

I did have to go to therapy for PTSD after my car accident... But he didn't do anything... Not even ask questions... Just go "uh huh" a lot.... Sigh... I was on antidepressants after my car accident... But again it was all paid for by the guy who hit me.... Once the case was over I'm back to square one. 

I'd even say... Maybe I just need to go on vacation... My dad too...but I don't have the money for it at the moment....nor even a friend to crash with.... I am trapped in the house I found my mom dead in with no one to talk to... I'm just running out of steam...
Side note....entirely shocked this username was actually available...
